description: This file implements the HeartbeatProcedure class and related classes for handling heartbeat signals within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It includes factory methods, a heartbeat handler, and logic for starting and finishing heartbeat pings, as well as error handling.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Handles individual heartbeat ping events, manages start, error, and finish states, and communicates with the HeartbeatProcedure.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Implements the heartbeat logic, including creating handlers, tracking pings sent, and signaling success or failure.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::IHeartbeatProcedureFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the HeartbeatProcedureFactory.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedureFactory::createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure with the given ackSender and pingId.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::createHandler
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatHandler for managing a heartbeat ping.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::onStart
methods.description: Marks the start of a heartbeat ping for a specific controlId.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::onFinish
methods.description: Marks the end of a heartbeat ping, updates success status.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler::pingSent
methods.description: Indicates that a ping has been sent.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::~HeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Destructor that sends the final heartbeat status.
